title: galium elatum var. insubricum
intro: Galium elatum var. insubricum, commonly known as Italian bedstraw, is a perennial plant species within the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, helping to soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
